description: A person credited in the production of book editions, published by the catalog as a stable reference target for the inline `community.lexicon.media.book.defs#contributor` entries on edition records. Records are keyed by TID and addressed under the catalog publisher's DID.

main.description: A contributor entity. The name and identifiers mirror `community.lexicon.media.book.defs#contributor`; `role` belongs to an individual credit on an edition and is deliberately absent here.

displayName.description: The contributor's name as it should be displayed, preserving the supplied name order. Identifiers, not this name, are the matching mechanism.

nameInverted.description: Optional name in filing or sorting order, when known, such as Le Guin, Ursula K. Consumers must not infer this by rearranging displayName.

description.description: Free-text biography or description of the contributor.

image.description: Optional portrait image. The blob must belong to the repository containing this record, so a catalog that does not own the bytes must use imageUrl instead. May coexist with imageUrl.

imageUrl.description: Optional portrait image URL. Unlike image, a URL does not preserve the bytes in the repository; it is what a host that does not own the blob can publish.

identifiers.description: Identifiers denoting this contributor in global or provider namespaces, compared exactly by issuer and value. Shared with the edition lexicons so an edition's inline identifiers and this record agree.

born.description: Birth date as a full ISO 8601 calendar date, exactly YYYY-MM-DD (for example 1929-10-21). Partial dates are not allowed, and the value must be a real calendar date: Lexicon strings cannot carry a regex, so writers must validate the pattern and the calendar (reject 2023-02-29, month 00 or 13, day 00 or 32).

died.description: Death date as a full ISO 8601 calendar date, exactly YYYY-MM-DD, with the same real-calendar validation as born.

createdAt.description: Time this contributor record was created, not a birth or death date.
